lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible across the lateral flank. Toward the anterior region, the clusters are smaller and more densely aggregated, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced centroids in the posterior direction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal ridge lines to form a grid. Individual high-intensity blobs are primarily centered within the resulting rectangular regions.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear features run horizontally across the upper two-thirds of the visible flank. These features are defined by a distinct brightness gradient, with pixel values transitioning from high-luminance at the dorsal edge of the ridge to a shadow gradient at the ventral edge.
